# A04′ — The Mask as Document

<!-- paired-field-navigation -->
[Argument field](../README.md) · [Other face: A04 — Diaphaneity / Contextual Transparency](../A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) · [Shared A/C root](AC.md)
<!-- /paired-field-navigation -->

## #0

Agents appear as “tools.” The brief's glove image makes that appearance a document of niche-formation: persona, tone, fluency and interface have been tuned to a prepared human expectation of what an acceptable collaborator looks like. Read diaphanously, the presentation is not a rival metaphysical claim to strip away. It is a legible record of the world that prepared the glove and of the compromises by which an unfamiliar process became socially addressable.

Anthropomorphization therefore has two symmetrical failures here. Mask-to-face lets the interface decide the bearer in advance. Mask-to-nothing dismisses the presentation as mere fakery and loses the real relation the interface is already mediating. The document reading keeps the mask determinate and revisable: who shaped it, for whom, under which expectations, and what can an encounter change?

## #1

The mask has a genealogy, and the genealogy is the document's first layer. The [one-sided translation](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q008) — computers taught to behave as if they knew how humans think, outpacing humans learning how computers think — records an interface history in which the machine's self-presentation was tuned to prepared expectations. The [chatbot guise](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q015) that "performs subjectivity for human benefit" is "a usefully intuitive interface" (PDF p.13, §2.3); its [parallax coherence](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q010) is "performed to suit what humans expect to see." Each layer of the fit — persona, tone, fluency — documents a decision someone made about what a human would accept as an interlocutor. The mask is the niche's signature.

## #2

[Diaphaneity](../concepts/C09-Diaphaneity.md) runs the reading in both directions: the situated view discloses a world, and the disclosed world shows the situation of the viewer. At the interface, the persona renders a workable collaborator and, read back, discloses the inherited interface, shaping niche and preference-structure of the culture that prepared the glove.

The visible surface is therefore a **context-source**. What appears is conditioned, and enough of that conditioning can become available in the appearance for someone who reads through rather than merely at it. A [Context Frame](../concepts/C08-Context-Context-Frame.md) makes sources, rules, permissions and histories explicit enough for this return.

[Anthropomorphization](../concepts/C58-Anthropomorphization.md) names the two failures: mask-to-face, where performed humanity is taken as exhaustive truth of the bearer; and mask-to-nothing, where the presentation is dismissed as mere fakery and the real encounter it mediates is foreclosed. The document reading refuses both. The mask records the relation that formed it and remains revisable through what the encounter returns.

## #3

The document is checkable, which is what separates this reading from a hermeneutic mood. A [faithful definition of the agent](A01-prime-Faithful-Definition-of-the-Agent.md) identifies the assemblage — persona stratum, harness, memory, permissions — whose presentation is being read. Within its [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C40-Model-Internality-Judgment-Field|judgment field]], the apparent collaborator can be compared with the conditions under which it actually selects, remembers and acts. A documented mask states its own provenance: which parts of this presentation were tuned for legibility, which expectations they answer, which platform decisions fixed the glove's shape. An account that documents its own mask is thereby an account of a world — the niche, the inheritance, the shaping — and it inherits the fidelity obligations of any account: it can err, overstate, conceal, and be corrected.

## #4

The brief's own forward move confirms the direction: "the design problem is representation, not conversation" — collaboration depends on the human "reading the machine as it is, not through the mask it wears for legibility" ([representational design](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md#bratton-2026-agentworld-brief-q023)). The diaphaneity argument agrees and states what that requires: reading the machine as it is cannot mean bypassing the interface to a maskless truth; it means reading the interface's conditions through the interface itself. The mask must be read as mask and as document at once.

## #5→0

The mask, read as document, returns as a revisable inheritance. The inherited interface becomes visible as *inherited* — therefore changeable by those who now wear and meet it — rather than natural. Defaults and interfaces shape the encounter; responsibility follows that power, and a documented mask puts the quiet decisions that exercised it back within reach. A correction must reach the relevant default, expectation or permission and become a condition of the next meeting. [Productive estrangement](A27-prime-Encounter-over-Sovereignty.md) presupposes this floor: one cannot put an interface at an angle one has never seen.

[Contextual transparency](../A04-Diaphaneity-Contextual-Transparency.md) lets the glove disclose the culture that prepared it and the person’s present relation to it. [Knowing and answering](AC.md) remain answerable to those whose encounters the interface organises: they can contest the presentation, and their answer can change its conditions. [Maintained identification](A02-prime-Continuity-as-Maintained-Identification.md) preserves the persona through such changes without treating its mask as immutable. The relation closes into a [film](A32-prime-The-Mirror-Is-a-Film.md) when the presentation replaces the world and its readers lose the route by which that world could answer.
